yufluentcn-visual-craft v1.0.0

- First public release of the cross-border ecommerce visual content coach skill.
- Provides cloud-driven workflows for A+ page structure, video storyboards, main image differentiation briefs, and image compliance checks.
- Outputs Markdown plans via Yufluent Harness for use in downstream imaging and rendering tools (no actual media generation).
- Includes detailed instructions for Agents, supported modes, trigger phrases, environment setup, and workflow examples.
- Enforces compliance rules: all outputs must be generated via Yufluent API; requires only TOKENAPI_KEY.
- Supports Amazon, Shopify, and TikTok; available in multiple languages.
